corpus_megabytes.description: Total size of the message files

distinct_sender_labels.description: Distinct sender labels parsed from message filenames

distinct_inbox_directories.description: Distinct inbox directories the messages are filed under

surviving_role_count.description: Roles the accompanying post names as the surviving cast

corpus_span_days.description: Days from the first dated message to the last

active_days.description: Calendar days carrying at least one message

one_day_labels.description: Sender labels whose first and last dated message fall on the same day

fortnight_labels.description: Sender labels whose first and last dated message are at least fourteen days apart

survivor_message_share_percent.description: Share of dated messages written by the four surviving labels

busiest_day_messages.description: Messages written on the busiest single day

peak_week_messages.description: Messages written in the busiest calendar week

final_week_messages.description: Messages written in the last calendar week of the corpus

peak_to_final_week_ratio.description: Busiest calendar week divided by the last calendar week, by message count

first_four_weeks_share_percent.description: Share of dated messages written in the first four calendar weeks

joiner_messages.description: Messages signed by the joiner label

joiner_career_hours.description: Elapsed time from the joiner label’s first message to its last

filenames_with_explicit_recipient.description: Filenames encoding an explicit recipient the filename convention never specified

filenames_with_allcaps_token.description: Filenames carrying at least one all-capitals status token

distinct_filename_tokens.description: Distinct status tokens counted in the filename vocabulary
